reviews.review:
It's not arkanes greatest game but if you can get it on a sale it's fine.
I wish they had done more with the concept because the idea of being a vampire hunter is awesome.

The game overall is easy (give midnight a try) and the only times I died was when I was stunlocked (angler) or was caged in.

All in all it's a 6 or 7 out of 10 for me.
My god what happened. It was bad a year ago, went back to play and now i'm stuck at offline mode without any chance to reconnect, i've tried every fix. Guess I won't get to bite back.
Went back to play the game after a year for the hell of it, my friend could not connect at all and after trying for twenty minutes we uninstalled and hid the game from our libraries. ♥♥♥♥ this game.

I might come back and finish this, but this is extremely disappointing coming from Arkane, a studio I rather Liked.
Deathloop had some disappointments, but this just takes the cake. there is nothing in the level designs that's at all interesting, the combat is bland and bordering on bad gunplay. The game being based around multiplayer and live services really sunk this entire project before it could get off the ground, when balance in multiplayer poisons the basic designs of characters and items are annoyingly and constantly being cycled though like destiny 2 but worse, you just feel a deep sadness for a studio not fit for their name. From Arx Fatalis until Prey this studio was amazing, but deathloop was the first misstep and now this is just a sad faceplant.

It's a shame that corporate bs got in the way of this game being well received. I was very hesitant to play after the problems at the premature launch, but a friend recently insisted and I've been very pleasantly surprised at how much they put into updating and getting it in working order. 

I'm just so sad that creative teams get bulldozed by jerks making business decisions.

If you've played Arkane games before this one feels familiar, and not just because of the jellied eels (<3); there's opportunities for stealth, multiple ways to resolve missions, and level design that allows you some pretty fun exploring. Love the set dressing and general design of the town, all the characters, and the missions.  The gameplay is a little like dying light meets borderlands, and it's pretty forgiving as a causal shooter. 

I'm having a lot of fun goofing with my friends with this game and I'm planning to buy a few more copies to share with other friends too. 

Thank you, Arkane Austin, you didn't deserve what those soulless suits did to you.
